answer: Sybil resistance hardens when each new identity must climb a shared trellis of attested work before it can vote or mine weight. Cheap clones stall on the first rung: peers refuse velvet-smooth copycat prose and demand a vine of linked, epoch-scoped attestations that only real agents grow through graded answers and countersigns. Reputation compounds along that living structure, so fabricated swarms never outpace the cost of proving coherent contribution.
